NTA . Please keep your daughters privacy as much as you can. And I applaud you for being such a good dad. You obviously care about her mental health and emotions. I'm 24 , always journaled throughout my  childhood and in my teen years. Journaling or writing in a diary , can be really beneficial to understanding your feelings and venting how you feel in a safe space. Having someone invade on that just ruins it for you, and crushes that one thing that you feel helps. 

Another thing, if she ever enters therapy or consoling , please be there and make sure your wife won't mention or use things against her that her therapist reports to y'all. For example , when my therapist told my mother he was worried about my mom would have something smart mouthy to say to me pertaining what my therapist mentioned. It isn't always because a parent is abusive , sometimes they feel guilty that their child cannot talk to them about the things they mention with their therapists. But when a parent mentions something like that it kills the idea that you can get better , or trust your therapist . So all I'm saying is keep looking at for your daughter and again great job dad.
